main.description: Returns recent activity for the authenticated tracked viewer.

associatedRecords.description: A map of AT URI to locally resolved associated record.

actors.description: A map of actor DID to app.bsky.actor.defs#profileViewBasic.

view.description: Collection-specific presentation data derived by the appview. Absent when no view builder is configured for the root collection.

relatedActivity.description: Page-local activity related to this parent by a configured collection and target path. Children are reverse chronological and do not contain related activity.

id.description: Opaque deterministic identifier for this grouping result.

groupBy.description: The grouping dimension used for this entry.

collection.description: The root-record collection shared by every child.

indexedAt.description: The activity event time of the newest child.

subject.description: The shared interaction target for a subject group.

actor.description: The shared author for an actor group.

items.description: Reverse-chronological child items; groups are never nested.

subscribed.description: Whether the viewer currently subscribes to this document's publication. False for non-document activity.

livestreamView.description: Appview-derived presentation data for place.stream.livestream activity.

thumb.description: CDN URL for the livestream record's thumbnail blob.

longformView.description: Reserved appview-derived presentation data for site.standard.document activity.

photoView.description: Reserved appview-derived presentation data for social.grain.photo activity.

recommendationView.description: Reserved appview-derived presentation data for site.standard.graph.recommend activity.

subscriptionView.description: Reserved appview-derived presentation data for site.standard.graph.subscription activity.

shareView.description: Appview-derived presentation data for a qualifying app.bsky.feed.post share.
